prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental event cue for the instant a hidden structure snaps into place. Around 108 BPM, A minor moving to A Dorian. Staccato pizzicato, marimba ostinato, prepared-piano clicks and one tight low tom used as a lock, not a trailer hit. Geometric, decisive, clean. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No brass fanfare, no huge drums, no riser-then-boom cliché.

[00:00–00:20] Offset marimba cells that almost line up, plus dry prepared-piano ticks.
[00:20–00:55] Pizzicato enters in competing meters; tension is rhythmic, not loud.
[00:55–01:35] Parts lock into a single grid; a muted brass stab marks the click, then holds.
[01:35–02:10] Ostinato brightens into A Dorian; still tight, still small-scale.
[02:10–02:30] Grid thins to two pitches and the lock-tom, then silence with ring-out.
